verdict.rationale: Postman docs say workspaces let team members "share, version, and discuss their work" (postman-docs-18), and commenting on APIs offers a review mechanism (postman-docs-39). However, neither is tied explicitly to automations such as scripts or workflows, and nothing in the pack documents rolling back. missing for 10: documented rollback/restore of prior versions, explicit versioning of automations (scripts/flows/collections), a formal review/approval workflow for changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
